dedupe_keys.name: ferc active hydropower licences list of actively licensed hydropower projects and associated data

description: The Active Licenses dataset, part of the FERC Active Hydropower Projects data asset, lists licensed hydropower projects. Contents: the dataset page describes it as a list of active licensed hydropower projects and associated data, in the hydropower industry and under the Office of Energy Projects, security level public; the column list and row count did not render from the cloud (dataset ID 31). Producer: FERC Office of Energy Projects. Coverage: United States. Format and access: CSV and XLSX downloads from the dataset page and an API endpoint (api.data.ferc.gov/v1/dataset/31) that needs a free key. Licence: only the portal's open data disclaimer (provided as is, no warranty, may be updated without notice). Caveats: this record rests on the dataset page text alone because the data view is script-rendered, so fields and counts should be confirmed in a browser; the same data asset also covers annual charges and notices of intent for conduit hydropower. Simulation uses: locating regulated hydropower projects in reservoir, dam and power system models. Related records: the FERC data portal record lists the sibling datasets; ORNL's environmental flow requirements dataset uses FERC licences.
